summary: IBM's corporate brand-font site, split into six numbered pages (Intro, Concept, Plexness, Languages, Gallery, Specs); only the Intro page was captured. It is pure brand-system communication: a giant light statement on IBM blue, a video of the 8-bar logo, three cropped logo letters annotated with the details Plex borrowed, a next-chapter link and IBM's legal footer, with a Carbon-component type tester in a global overlay. Compared with foundry microsites there is no buying, no designer voice and no story beyond the logo; IBM's cookie banner covers every crop.

instances.look: Fixed 64px IBM-red top bar (HTML only, its red rule shows in the crops): numbered page tabs '01 Intro · 02 Concept · 03 Plexness · 04 Languages · 05 Gallery · 06 Specs' with the current one marked, and '↗ Get Plex®' at the right linking to GitHub releases; on mobile a dropdown '01 Intro ▾' with extra links (Google Fonts, YouTube, IBM Design Language)

Full IBM-blue screen with one enormous white sentence in IBM Plex Sans Light, left-aligned over ~8 lines: 'IBM Plex® is our new typeface. It's global, it's versatile and it's distinctly IBM.'; an 'Open Typetester' link (white circle) at the right; IBM's cookie banner covers the lower part in the capture
instances.ux: Intro: horizontal blue-and-white bars (the IBM 8-bar motif) wipe across the screen before the page settles; 'Open Typetester' opens a global tester overlay
instances.learn: A brand typeface can introduce itself with a single possessive sentence ('our new typeface… distinctly IBM') set huge in the lightest weight: the statement is the specimen

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440 × ~1640 (two screens); text block from x≈36, ~700px wide (2–3 words per line), 8 lines; circular tester link (~90px) at the right edge mid-height
reconstruction.typography: ~150px IBM Plex Sans Light, white, leading ~1.1, tracking slightly negative; ® as superscript; nav labels 12px Plex Sans
reconstruction.behaviour: Load sequence: striped 8-bar wipe (~2s); static afterwards; the link a.cta-link.global-typetester-link toggles .global-typetester
reconstruction.content: Brand statement: global, versatile, distinctly IBM

instances.look: Never cut as a block (global overlay in the HTML, opened from the hero's 'Open Typetester'): a black full-screen section with two Carbon dropdowns (family: Plex Sans / Sans Italic / Mono / Mono Italic / Serif / Serif Italic / Sans Condensed / Condensed Italic; weight: Thin … Bold incl. 'Text'), a size slider 12–400 with a numeric box, and the editable word 'Eyeeeeeee' at 180px
instances.ux: Pick a family and weight from selects, drag or type the size, edit the sample; the default 'Eyeeeeeee' nods to the Eye-Bee-M rebus
instances.learn: Build the tester from your own design-system components (Carbon select and slider) so it looks native to the brand's tools

reconstruction.layout: Full-viewport black overlay; control row at the top (two ~250px selects, a ~300px slider with min/max labels and a 60px number input); sample below, left-aligned, single line
reconstruction.typography: Sample 180px default, IBM Plex Mono Italic Bold (random/initial class 'ibm-plex-mono-italic weight-bold'), white; controls 14px Plex Sans
reconstruction.behaviour: select#select-id-font-select and #select-id-weight-select swap classes on the section; input[type=range] 12–400 (step 1, value 180) + number input set the sample's font-size

instances.ux: Muted looping video, separate mobile cut
instances.learn: When a typeface descends from a logo, show the logo first, alone, so the next section's details have a referent

instances.look: On light grey, three huge cropped black-and-white letter squares in a zig-zag (I left, B right, M left), each with a thin pale-blue circle drawn around one detail (the slab serif of I, the right-angled inner counter of B, the point where M's strokes meet) and a small monospace caption '[↑] The first (and most obvious) detail borrowed was the slab serif.'
instances.learn: Crop each letter so tight the detail fills the frame, circle it with a hairline, and caption it in mono with an arrow pointing up: three details, three screens

reconstruction.layout: ~2400px; squares ~670×560px alternating x=32 and x=736, each followed by a caption block (~280px wide) under it; ~120px vertical gap
reconstruction.typography: Captions ~12px IBM Plex Mono Regular, leading ~1.5, prefixed '[↑]'; letters are graphic crops (IBM logo / Plex Bold forms), white on black squares or black on white
reconstruction.content: Three borrowed logo details: slab serif, vertical stroke and right-angled interior counters, the point at the M's intersection
reconstruction.assets: Three cropped letter SVGs with circle highlights
